sc_momentum.definition: SC_MOMENTUM composite [0,100], uncapped weighted average of flow/energy/structure/mp/elder (scoring.py v1.8.0); floors not applied to the composite, Elder gate enforced at qualification.
sc_momentum.method: scoring.py: uncapped weighted composite [0,100] of flow/energy/structure/mp/elder; floors not applied to composite; Elder gate at qualification.

knn_prob.definition: K-NEAREST-NEIGHBORS directional probability (0-1) for the current CHoCH: the win-rate of the K most similar HISTORICAL CHoCH events on this SAME ticker (matched on 3 features — volume-delta, ATR-normalised displacement, velocity — via Euclidean distance), where 'win' = the move's max favorable excursion exceeded its max adverse excursion within a fixed lookahead. This IS genuine instance-based learning (a real kNN), not a black box — but it's simple (3 hand-picked features, no training beyond the ticker's own history) and should be read as one more context signal, not a probability of profit. Null when there's no CHoCH or too few historical analogs to query.
knn_prob.method: smart_money_knn.py: kNN over ticker's own CHoCH history → directional probability.

knn_significant.definition: True iff knn_prob clears a fixed threshold in either direction (≥60% or ≤40% by default). CAVEAT (AIC Charter Amendment v2.8, 2026-07-15 ruling): this is a plain threshold check on a SMALL neighbor count (k=5 by default), NOT a statistical significance test — at k=5, 3-of-5 agreeing clears the 60% bar trivially, including by chance. Carries no p-value or confidence-interval semantics. Read as 'the threshold was crossed', not 'the analogs meaningfully agree'.
knn_significant.method: smart_money_knn.py: threshold flag (NOT a significance test).

sc_m_gate_detail.definition: Per-engine SC_MOMENTUM gate pass/fail (dict): {flow, energy, structure, mp, elder} each True/False vs the SC_M_GATES threshold — so you read WHICH check a name is failing without recomputing. false = that engine is below its floor.

sc_p_gate_detail.definition: Per-engine SC_POSITION gate pass/fail (dict): {flow, energy, structure, mp, bq, k39} each True/False vs the SC_P_GATES threshold (k39 = the weekly confirmation gate; null if unavailable).

beta_30d.definition: 30-day beta vs SPY — the portfolio-gate window (D-6).
beta_30d.method: 30-day beta vs SPY (the gate window, D-6).
